title: ClassifierMetricsFile
description: On-disk shape of round-0/metrics.json, the pre-round classifier output. The metrics array is also carried verbatim inside the ClassifierMetricsPayload event on dashboard-events.jsonl.

version.description: Snapshot schema version. v0.4 Phase 1B ships version=1.

generated_at.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp of when the classifier ran.

model.description: Resolved model ID (or custom command tag) used for the classifier call. Informational.

metrics.description: 5-10 question-specific metrics plus the mandatory dissent axis (6-11 items total). Exactly one metric must have id 'dissent_axis' and 'mandatory: true'.

scale.description: Upper bound of the score range; scores are integers 1..=scale. Tight cap keeps the dashboard bar-chart renderable without rescaling.
